objectives.en: Recognise the four types of structural isomerism

narration.en: cis-[PtCl₂(NH₃)₂] is the anticancer drug cisplatin; its trans isomer is useless as a drug. Same atoms, different arrangement, very different behaviour.
narration.kn: cis-[PtCl₂(NH₃)₂] ಕ್ಯಾನ್ಸರ್ ವಿರೋಧಿ ಔಷಧ ಸಿಸ್‌ಪ್ಲಾಟಿನ್; ಅದರ trans ಸಮಾಂಗಿ ಔಷಧವಾಗಿ ಉಪಯೋಗವಿಲ್ಲ. ಅದೇ ಪರಮಾಣುಗಳು, ಬೇರೆ ಜೋಡಣೆ, ಬೇರೆ ಗುಣ.

body.en: Stereoisomers have the same bonds but different arrangements in space. Geometrical isomerism appears in square planar MA₂B₂ (cis and trans) and in octahedral MA₄B₂ and [MX₂(AA)₂] (cis and trans). Octahedral MA₃B₃ gives fac (three like ligands on one face) and mer (around a meridian). Tetrahedral complexes do not show geometrical isomerism. Optical isomers are non-superimposable mirror images (d and l), common in octahedral complexes with didentate ligands: [Co(en)₃]³⁺ and cis-[PtCl₂(en)₂]²⁺ are optically active; the trans form is not.
body.kn: ಸ್ಟೀರಿಯೋ ಸಮಾಂಗಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅದೇ ಬಂಧಗಳು, ಬೇರೆ ಆಕಾಶೀಯ ಜೋಡಣೆ. ಜ್ಯಾಮಿತೀಯ ಸಮಾಂಗತೆ: cis-trans, fac-mer. ಚತುಷ್ಫಲಕೀಯ ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಜ್ಯಾಮಿತೀಯ ಸಮಾಂಗತೆ ಇಲ್ಲ. ದೃಕ್ ಸಮಾಂಗಿಗಳು ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಹೊಂದಿಕೆಯಾಗದ ಕನ್ನಡಿ ಬಿಂಬಗಳು.

body.en: Structural isomers have different bonds. Linkage isomerism: an ambidentate ligand binds through different atoms, e.g. [Co(NH₃)₅(NO₂)]Cl₂ (yellow, N-bound) and [Co(NH₃)₅(ONO)]Cl₂ (red, O-bound). Coordination isomerism: ligands are exchanged between a complex cation and a complex anion, e.g. [Co(NH₃)₆][Cr(CN)₆] and [Cr(NH₃)₆][Co(CN)₆]. Ionisation isomerism: a counter ion swaps with a ligand, e.g. [Co(NH₃)₅(SO₄)]Br and [Co(NH₃)₅Br]SO₄. Solvate (hydrate) isomerism: water inside or outside the sphere, e.g. [Cr(H₂O)₆]Cl₃ (violet) and [Cr(H₂O)₅Cl]Cl₂·H₂O (grey-green).
body.kn: ರಚನಾ ಸಮಾಂಗಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬಂಧಗಳೇ ಬೇರೆ: ಬಂಧನ, ಸಮನ್ವಯ, ಅಯಾನೀಕರಣ ಮತ್ತು ದ್ರಾವಕ (ಜಲ) ಸಮಾಂಗತೆ.

problem.en: How many geometrical isomers does [Co(NH₃)₃(NO₂)₃] have? Is either optically active?

steps.en: fac: the three NH₃ on one triangular face; mer: the three NH₃ in a line around the metal.
Both have mirror planes, so neither is optically active.

answer.en: 2 geometrical isomers (fac and mer); no optical isomers

narration.en: Let us solve this together. How many geometrical isomers does [Co(NH₃)₃(NO₂)₃] have? Is either optically active?

steps.en: trans has a mirror plane: 1 isomer, optically inactive.
cis is chiral: d and l forms. Total = 1 + 2 = 3.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Count all the stereoisomers of [CoCl₂(en)₂]⁺.

body.en: Tetrahedral: never geometrical isomers. Square planar MA₂B₂: 2. Octahedral MA₄B₂: 2 (cis, trans). MA₃B₃: 2 (fac, mer). [M(AA)₃]: 2 optical. [MX₂(AA)₂]: 3 (trans + d,l-cis).

narration.en: Quick isomer counts. Tetrahedral: never geometrical isomers. Square planar MA₂B₂: 2. Octahedral MA₄B₂: 2 (cis, trans). MA₃B₃: 2 (fac, mer). [M(AA)₃]: 2 optical. [MX₂(AA)₂]: 3 (trans + d,l-cis).
